docBasis.excerpt: Ordinary Chat is for immediate collaboration ... High-constraint execution belongs to explicit Task Loop runs.
Chat 可以显示升级建议；创建 root/启动 run 需要显式确认。

enforcingOwner.mechanism: The only constructor of TaskLoopUpgradeSuggestion hard-codes requiresUserConfirmation: true, createsTaskLedgerRoot: true and startsRun: 'after-user-confirmation' (lines 713-715); the Chat detector at src/pages/Chat/task-loop-upgrade.ts:74 can only emit this shape, so Chat cannot start a Task Loop run on its own.

relations.notes: Unit-level enforcement is executed; the Electron E2E exists but was not run in C1.

docBasis.excerpt: Durable task facts belong to Task Ledger.
Each edge names the owning authority boundary; it is not permission, an inverse relation, or a transitively inferred fact.

enforcingOwner.mechanism: Every Task Ledger node projected from a Chat session's orchestrator plan is stamped readonlyProjection: true, source: 'orchestrator.plan' (lines 113-122); isReadOnlyTaskLedgerProjection (line 142) is the single predicate the Task Ledger page uses to treat such nodes as read-only (src/pages/TaskLedger/index.tsx:50).

regressionEntry.asserts: every created node has metadata.readonlyProjection === true
isReadOnlyTaskLedgerProjection distinguishes projected from ordinary nodes

relations.notes: Shares its enforcing owner with chat-plan--projects--task-ledger: the code tags the projection source as 'orchestrator.plan' and does not distinguish an ordinary Chat initiator from a Chat Plan initiator. The split into two `from` endpoints is documentary; no second code path exists for ordinary Chat.

docBasis.excerpt: Chat Plan supports read-only projection plus lightweight edit drafts ... It is not a full DAG editor.
allowedReferences: ['Task Ledger read-only node projection', 'lightweight reorder/disable/note edit draft']

regressionEntry.asserts: every created node has metadata.readonlyProjection === true
isReadOnlyTaskLedgerProjection distinguishes projected from ordinary nodes

relations.notes: Lightweight edit drafts (P1-02) live in src/lib/orchestration-plan-edit-draft.ts and write projectionEdit metadata, not Task Ledger facts; they do not widen this boundary.

docBasis.excerpt: 它拥有：Task Ledger root；checkpoint；repair；blocked；evidence gate；loop run state。
Task Ledger 拥有用户可见任务事实、review flags、history 和 Task Loop 相关根节点。
ClawGraph/Task Loop 不能替代 Task Ledger 验收。
sourceOfTruth: 'Task Ledger root plus loop run/checkpoint state'

enforcingOwner.mechanism: A loop run resolves or creates its Task Ledger root before any record exists (lines 3377-3394) and throws 'Cannot start /loop without a Task Ledger root' when the root creator fails or returns an empty id (lines 3395-3405); recordTaskLoopCheckpoint (line 2808) refuses to checkpoint without taskLedgerRootId. Completion authority stays with Task Ledger, not with the loop.

regressionEntry.asserts: rejects with /Cannot start \/loop without a Task Ledger root/ when the root cannot be created
no relation has from === 'task-ledger' (Task Ledger never roots in, projects to or references another concept)

docBasis.excerpt: May reference a Task Ledger node id one-way. It must not mirror or two-way-sync Task Ledger.
`TaskLedgerReference` is one-way from Workboard/runtime/plugin scheduling state to a Task Ledger node id.
Workboard/ClawGraph 的调度状态可以单向引用 Task Ledger node，但不应双向镜像成第二任务账本。
TF-0449: explicit inheritance semantics for the one-way Workboard -> Task Ledger reference

enforcingOwner.mechanism: The reference type carries a single literal direction 'workboard-to-task-ledger' (line 2), the constructor can only emit that direction (line 25), the guard accepts only the closed key set direction/source/taskLedgerNodeId/workboardCardId (line 36-38), and the inheritance table (line 82) is the sole owner of which fields may cross one-way. Workboard consumes the type verbatim at openclaw_runtime/extensions/workboard/src/types.ts:287,302.

regressionEntry.asserts: closed doesNotInherit list (status, completion and ledger-owned fields never cross)
the references-one-way edge into task-ledger comes from workboard with authorityBoundary one-way-reference
createTaskLedgerReference has no sync / taskLedgerMirror property

docBasis.excerpt: Routing Memo is an internal diagnostic; it cannot affect routing until same-session scorecard-backed quality input is available.
`active`：只有同 session Task Loop scorecard-backed quality 才能影响路由。
P1-07 safeClaim: Routing Memo may become active only from a server-resolved, same-session Task Loop scorecard authority reference.

enforcingOwner.mechanism: Authority becomes 'active' only when the quality authority has state 'active', source 'task_loop_verified_scorecard', scorecardBacked, verified and routingEligible (lines 155-161); anything else stays 'shadow' with reason 'missing-scorecard-quality' (lines 169-174). The authority object is produced server-side by resolveQualityAuthority (openclaw_runtime/src/gateway/server-methods/role-orchestration-methods.ts:124-157), which ignores client-supplied qualityState (line 131), requires the originating sessionKey (line 136) and rejects a Task Loop run that belongs to a different session (line 146). orchestrationQualityAffectsRouting (shared/product-semantics.ts:631) is the shared predicate state === 'active'.

regressionEntry.asserts: pilot active without verified scorecard stays shadow (missing-scorecard-quality)
a Task Loop run from a different session resolves to authority state 'unavailable' (/different session/i)

relations.notes: Static reading only: this manifest does not prove any live session produced a verified scorecard. A documented same-session claim without a server-resolved receipt remains documented-only at runtime, which is exactly what resolveQualityAuthority enforces.
